heads: one verified current kind-10050 head ID per envelope, in the same order; recipient copies first and the canonical sender copy last
events: complete original signed kind-1059 JSON objects, not reserialized strings; every recipient and the sender have exactly one copy
authority: actual full human principal, matching current canonical independently held identity; managed sends are constructed inside the managed provider and cannot be replaced by submitted candidates
admission: verify every outer signature, distinct recipients, sender copy, current signed inbox heads and frozen target lists before staging the complete batch
commit: the complete NCJ2 transaction and the first operation receipt commit together before any success or external EVENT; failure discards every prepared byte
replay: private-provider HMAC of the complete canonical custody request; same operation/digest returns the first complete sealed manifest, with no second envelope set
privacy: only original public routing heads and encrypted envelopes cross this endpoint; no private content, inner rumor/room ID, conversation key or signing key
result: coax.native.nostr-result.v1alpha1, custody service, seal action, and coax.native.nostr-sealed.v1alpha1 payload
